title: Universal Import Adapter Framework
start_authority: Owner Continue freshly verified exact canonical AIOC/application heads, confirmed no competing MAI-06 branch/PR, re-read completed MAI-01..05 evidence, and resolved provider-specific adapter seams using current official Tiled/LDtk/Foundry format evidence before implementation.
objective: Implement a deterministic provider-neutral import-adapter registry and bounded proof adapters that translate source-specific structured map/scene data into completed MAI-02..05 presentation contracts while preserving source/checksum/license/provenance/unsupported metadata and never mutating canonical owner-domain state.

selection.explicit_adapter_id: Pinned adapter selection resolves exactly and cannot be overridden by detection.
selection.automatic_detection: Unpinned registered detectors execute in stable adapter-ID order and require exactly one strong match.
selection.ambiguous_or_no_match: Ambiguous and unsupported sources fail explicitly rather than being guessed.

resolved_contract.mapping: Only explicit provider semantics enter completed MAI-02..05 presentation fields; raw provider documents and unmapped semantics remain preserved evidence.
resolved_contract.partial_packages: Warnings remain explicit partial outcomes; malformed required projection data remains invalid-source; no semantic or asset invention occurs.
resolved_contract.owner_rule: MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration remain canonical owner truth.

completion_rule: Exact head passed application Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows MAI-06 Validation Core with matching deterministic receipt, and deterministic cross-platform comparison before squash merge. No repair cycle was required.
nonauthorization: migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta
next_action: MAI-06 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority. MAI-07 may be selected_not_started only; a future owner Continue must freshly verify canonical heads and governed-start MAI-07 before resolver/substitution implementation.
